content: Un'tüüb a Ikööŋ amu Klistɔ
Abun, mɛ Pɔl, mbuur a bɔlokà ntɔn Mwol, mɛ amàlabɔɔn, làpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ akà làbeel làwɛl bɛ,
unsà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n lanswà, duu, anà nkääŋ a mpem. Làkääŋà mpem bɛ a bɛ unsà ukwen.
Làsi ngwal mukaar un'tüüb a Dweelà u mbwo a duu.
Ndür yà mwɛy anà Dweelà wà mwɛy, abun sye Nzam kàlabeel unsà làkyän làmwɛy mpɛl,
Mwol mwɛy, làkwikilà làmwɛy mpɛl, ndüümà mwɛy mpɛl,
Nzam mwɛy, Taarà a baar banswà, awà udu a baar banswà, afàsal u mbwo a baar banswà, anà afàkal amu baar banswà.
Wɛɛ mbuur mbuur amu bi kàwɛl kab a ngway asànaa kà isii a kab a Klistɔ.
Kyakin bàtɛɛnà naa:
Kyekà, « Nde kàbeenà », ikaswaŋà aben? Imɛnà naa nde sye kàtàtyà tii u ngyɛl a mɛɛn.
Mbuur awà kàtyà, mbuur nsil wa sye kàbeenà du aŋàlyaaŋ du lanswà, ntɔn muyööl indiir byanswà.
Wà nde nsil wa kàbuul amwɛy antööm, bumwɛy aŋangɔɔm, apaay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, aseey anà alɔɔŋ,
ntɔn mupà aŋin'kyɛɛl inwään byàŋàkwo mukwey isal ntɔn mutɔŋ ndür a Klistɔ.
Tii kunà isàbulà bi banswà un'tüüb mwɛy unsà làkwikilà anà unsà ngyööb a Mwan a Nzam, unsà indweer, asànaa Klistɔ unsà ngyööl ande.
Abun, bi ifàsàkal anki asànaa ambɛy, bàŋàsɛk, bàŋàtàtɔɔm tɔɔm a un'pöb a an'lɔɔŋ a baar a loor anà impeen aba mubwiy baar ndwaŋ.
Wɛɛ, mukyään ndandaa unsà ukwen, bi isàyɛl unsà indiir byanswà ntsü akà Klistɔ awà un'tswe.
Yà u mbwo ande waa ndür yanswà ayà swalaa, yàŋàtüüb ubwaŋàbwaŋ u mbwo a nkɔn aya, ntɔn mupà mbwo akà itiir a ndür imwɛy imwɛy musal isal a kya, ntɔn muyɛl anà mutɔŋ ya ŋakwo unsà ukwen.
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ uboo a Klistɔ
Le ayà in'tɛn mɛ anà in'tà mɛ imbäl kà ikɔb a Mwol: twon lan'fàkal asànaa baar mpa abà Ayudà, ntɔn un'yɛnà aba ndöŋ yatɛy.
An'kyän aba mà u mpib anà ba sye bà angyey u mɔ̈ɔ̈ a Nzam, ntɔn nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a ngyööb ifàtwaal bwoor u mpem aba.
Unsà nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a an'kyän aba, ba bàkyàbilà unsà ipasàsɛ anà bàkyàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba unsà ŋingyäy ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ntsüü anà unkaam.
Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ Klistɔ làlɔŋàkà anki abunà,
kya isàkal naa ndandaa bɛ làkyàwem naa bàyäm ntɔn nde, isàkal naa nde bàlalɔŋ, unsà ndandaa ayà amu Klistɔ,
làpiy nkääl abɛ yà itaan anà làkɔɔb imbuur abɛ kyà itaan akyà ifàbwà u mbwo a ngyal a loor.
Wɛy bɛ làfurà bàkün unsà dweelà a un'yɛnà abɛ,
anà làbwäär mbuur akün, awà bàkyer asànaa kàkwen Nzam unsà balàbal anà un'kyɛɛl abyà ifàfà u ndandaa.
Abun, bɛ làbà aŋàlwomà unsà loor: wɛy mbuur mbuur utɛn ndandaa akà mbääb ande, ntɔn bi ibà atɔŋ bi a bi.
Nkye bɛ làbà u nkyɛl? Twon lan'kyer man'be, twon lan'kal u nkyɛl tii mpal làkàminà taaŋ.
Twon lan'pà ipöl akà ileŋ.
Wɛy mbüüb ukɔ̈ɔ̈n afàyib, wɛɛ nde usi ngwal musal unsà lää kà an'kɔɔ ande ŋakwo, ntɔn nde umɛn undiir akab akà mbuur awe anà ngyal awa.
Wɛy ndaa a nsɔɔr ikɔ̈ɔ̈n atoo u mun abɛ. Wɛɛ, kya ngyal isàkal, làtɛn ndaa aŋàbwaŋ, yan'kwo mutɔŋ anà mupà kab a ngway akà baar bàweemà ya.
Twon lan'pà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl ngyɛb, Dweelà kàlasi Nzam asànaa inyɛm, ntɔn ilä a ntsuuŋ.
Wɛy naa itsumbuun, umpɔr, nkyɛl, an'sye anà in'tswe, bya byanswà byàdiimà amu bɛ anà ube banswà.
Làkäl bàŋàbwaŋ bɛ a bɛ, làkäl anà nkääŋ a mpem, làdwääl nkul bɛ a bɛ, asànaa kàladwääl Nzam amu Klistɔ.
